description: Schedule or queue 1 to 20 approved drafts atomically in one call (Studio and Pro). Each item takes either a future UTC scheduledAt or queue: true, not both. Call it only after the user said yes to every draft and its time. If any draft fails validation, version check, pace or plan limits, nothing is queued. Repeating with the same idempotencyKey and items answers the same deliveries and never posts twice.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you make up for this batch request, 8 to 190 characters (a UUID works). Repeating the request with the same key and items answers the same deliveries and never posts twice.

items.description: One to 20 approved drafts to schedule or queue together atomically.

id.description: A validated draft id from drafts_list or drafts_create.

queue.description: true puts this draft into the next free posting time instead of a chosen time. Do not combine with scheduledAt.

scheduledAt.description: When to post this draft, in UTC ending in Z. Give either scheduledAt or queue: true, not both.

version.description: The draft’s version as you last read it. A different number is refused.

name: schedule_batch
title: Schedule a batch of posts
